title: Replayed-from-cache step against a changed app version
closed: #41 binds validation evidence to the approved build (validation build_digest, rechecked after the run and at promote) and to a Kane run started during this validation (kane_runs; a cached observation is <id>:stale_kane_run). Receipts reject evidence from another build or Kane run, and a VerifiedRunReceipt needs both bindings. The binding sits on the receipt and the validation record, not on BrowserObservation itself.
